parole.significato: Any member of the genus Lantana of perennial verbenas with aromatic flower clusters.
parole.testo: From translingual Lantana (genus name), from (northern dialect) Italian lantana (“the wayfaring-tree, Viburnum lantana”).

parole.significato: Any of various grasses, of the genus Melica, from northern temperate regions.
parole.testo: From translingual Melica (genus name), probably from Italian melica, meliga (“sorghum, millet”).

parole.significato: Any rust fungus of the genus Puccinia.
parole.testo: Borrowed from translingual Puccinia, from Italian Puccini, named after Tommaso Puccini.
